    A is a positive filtered deformation of A₀ #

    positive-deformations.tex: "the filtration F^nA(x, y) = J^n(P_y, P_x) of Section 3 makes A a positive filtered deformation of A₀: by Construction 2.8, its associated graded algebra is A₀."

    Here: the projective corner (Alg (P_p)_p)ᵒᵖ of ind(mod A) is filtered by the radical powers of its entries; the initial forms of Proposition 2.6 (phi) identify the layers with the length-graded pieces of A₀ multiplicatively (posFiltProj). The Peirce isomorphism transports this to A (posFiltA).
